The overlap is more specific in wording, genre, and rhetorical sequence than the merely topical Italian connections in other candidates.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I want to send my warmest congratulations to you and to the other members of the Italian team","parent_excerpt":"I send my warmest congratulations to you on becoming Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.","explanation":"Distinctive near-verbatim congratulatory opening."},{"child_excerpt":"This outstanding accomplishment under the most hazardous of conditions is a fine testimonial to your superb skill and fortitude.","parent_excerpt":"I feel confident you will bring to your new task the same vision, determination and sympathetic understanding you have shown in the past.","explanation":"Both follow the congratulations by praising personal qualities demonstrated through demanding achievement."},{"child_excerpt":"Our nation is proud to have witnessed within its own borders this conquest","parent_excerpt":"Your distinguished career is well known on this side of the Atlantic, and has earned our widespread respect.","explanation":"Both broaden personal congratulations into national admiration and respect."}]}
